data.notes: Aspen’s February 2026 calendar was unusually electronic-heavy, led by Palm Tree Music Festival, Snow Lodge après-ski programming, and big-name Belly Up club shows.

events.title: Palm Tree Music Festival Aspen
events.summary: Two-day winter edition of Palm Tree Music Festival in Aspen, with the ticketing source listing Kygo, Calvin Harris, MAU P, Sammy Virji, and more.

events.title: High Tops: The Chainsmokers
events.summary: Aspen Snowmass and Belly Up Aspen hosted The Chainsmokers for a free, limited-capacity high-alpine concert at the top of Aspen Mountain, with DJ Lo_G opening.

events.title: Kaytranada at The Snow Lodge Aspen Music Series
events.venueName: The Snow Lodge at The St. Regis Aspen
events.summary: The Snow Lodge’s Winter 2025–26 Music Series listed Kaytranada for its Après-Ski Courtyard program on February 13.

events.title: PAWSA at The Snow Lodge Aspen Music Series
events.venueName: The Snow Lodge at The St. Regis Aspen
events.summary: The Snow Lodge’s February lineup confirmed PAWSA for an Après-Ski Courtyard event on February 14.

events.title: Dennis Cruz at The Snow Lodge Aspen Music Series
events.venueName: The Snow Lodge at The St. Regis Aspen
events.summary: The Snow Lodge’s Winter 2025–26 Music Series listed Dennis Cruz for the Après-Ski Courtyard on February 21.

events.title: Lupe Fiasco, Cassian & Arodes at The Snow Lodge Aspen Music Series
events.venueName: The Snow Lodge at The St. Regis Aspen
events.summary: The Snow Lodge’s February schedule closed with an Après-Ski Courtyard bill featuring Lupe Fiasco, Cassian, and Arodes on February 28.

events.title: deadmau5
events.summary: Belly Up Aspen confirmed a sold-out 21+ deadmau5 show with support from Lo G on February 27.

events.title: Two Friends
events.summary: Belly Up Aspen listed Two Friends with 9B49 for a sold-out 21+ late show on February 28.

events.title: Ghostface Killah
events.summary: Ghostface Killah brought the Supreme Clientele 2 Tour to Belly Up Aspen with Kid Kamillion on February 10.

events.title: Tank & The Bangas
events.summary: Belly Up Aspen confirmed Tank & The Bangas with DJ Zeus for an all-ages show on February 4.

events.title: Meshell Ndegeocello: The Gospel Of James Baldwin
events.summary: Wheeler Opera House presented Meshell Ndegeocello’s No More Water: The Gospel of James Baldwin program on February 11, co-presented with Wheeler Associates.

events.title: An Acoustic Evening with The Band Perry
events.summary: Wheeler Opera House confirmed an acoustic February 14 performance by The Band Perry, highlighting the Grammy-, CMA-, and ACM-winning act’s new duo chapter.
